summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Rashisense MVP. Backend: 20/20 pytest cases pass covering auth (email + username login, /auth/me, bearer), rashi calculate (chart/gemstone/reading fields, bad-date 400, determinism, saved-when-authenticated), readings CRUD, admin stats/users/logs, 403 on user-attempting-admin. Frontend: landing, calculator (anon + authed), signup + auto-redirect to dashboard, dashboard history + delete, admin login with username 'admin' + admin control hub all render correctly.

issues: 'Tip: create a free account' link renders even during page-load race before AuthContext hydration on authenticated hard-reload; harmless but flickers briefly.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: `/api/rashi/calculate` returns full mongo document 'result' with mixed structure; response payload leaks internal 'user_id' when saved (kept in returned dict). Consider stripping user_id from response.
server.py: startup uses deprecated @app.on_event; migrate to lifespan handlers (FastAPI >=0.95). Non-blocking.
server.py CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True; browsers will reject credentialed requests with wildcard. For production set explicit origins.

astro.py compute_chart treats naive datetime as UTC (no timezone conversion from birth place). Since problem statement acknowledges 'deterministic simplified Vedic model', acceptable, but ascendant computation is very approximate.
Dashboard.jsx: `.catch(() => {})` on /readings load silently swallows errors; consider surfacing a toast.

Calculator.jsx: after successful save, no dashboard refetch (fine since user navigates), but 'Tip: create a free account' text uses AuthContext user only — a quick guard on `loading` would prevent flicker.
test_credentials: Admin: username 'admin' / password 'Rashi@2026'. Test users registered dynamically via /api/auth/register.
seed_data_creation: Registered several TEST users during runs (test_user_*, test_ui_*, test_flow_*, test_dbg_*) and created 1 reading; test also exercises delete so most are cleaned up. Admin panel shows 3 leftover TEST users (safe to keep).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression tests at /app/backend/tests/test_rashisense.py; run with `pytest backend/tests/test_rashisense.py -v` from /app. All UI critical flows validated end-to-end including admin login via username. Only cosmetic AuthContext hydration flicker noted; no functional bugs.
